jobs.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: clean reusable landscape arena BACKGROUND PLATE. Input image is the approved style and architecture reference. Match the reference's sophisticated realistic stylized rendered game artwork: ivory polymer, graphite undercarriages, brushed champagne metal, muted burnt orange and teal, small status slits, believable soft amber/cyan arena lighting, readable robust silhouettes, no cartoon outlines or giant robot eyes. Assets for a side-view 2D physics game.
Create a clean 16:10 image containing ONLY the enclosed future resort sports hall environment. Preserve the dome, cyan roof strips, tall metal ribs, glass windows, distant outdoor palms, warm amber lamps and restrained polished slate court surface. REMOVE ALL people, drones, gifts, hazards, volleyball, center net, wall service buttons, UI, score digits and all text. REMOVE the massive dark foreground plinth and outer stone side walls: fill their space with the hall interior so game code can draw the actual physical floor and side barriers. Camera remains straight side view, no tilted horizon. The empty slate floor occupies only the bottom 8% of the image, extends continuously beyond both edges, no foreground edge or border. Large quiet unobstructed central gameplay region. No static shadows of removed objects, no ghosts, no extra equipment, no signage, no particles. Do not flatten the rendering. Opaque background.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: TRANSPARENT game sprite sheet with exactly TWO equal square cells side by side, 2 columns by 1 row, no grid lines or text. Input image: design and rendering reference. Match the reference's sophisticated realistic stylized rendered game artwork: ivory polymer, graphite undercarriages, brushed champagne metal, muted burnt orange and teal, small status slits, believable soft amber/cyan arena lighting, readable robust silhouettes, no cartoon outlines or giant robot eyes. Assets for a side-view 2D physics game.
Transparent RGBA background throughout, no backdrop, checkerboard, ground plane, shadow floor or vignette.
LEFT CELL: one complete luxury-resort quadcopter courier, facing slightly right in the same side view as reference. Flat travel-case ivory hull with teal status slit, champagne-metal spine, four distinct short rotor arms and their gold motor hubs in reference perspective. Four thin protective arcs. NO spinning blades or blur discs: rotors will be animated in code. NO cargo, dangling gift, cables or gripper extending far below; small underbody clasp only. Full object fits inside central 80% of its square cell with ample clear padding, centered.
RIGHT CELL: one separate premium cream hard-shell GIFT PARCEL matching reference, champagne corner clips, teal vertical ribbon band, recognizable simple bow, small luggage tag with tiny palm pictogram, no text. Facing same camera, compact almost square body. Entire parcel and bow centered inside central 70% of the cell. No drone or attachment. Both assets isolated, disconnected, aligned to a regular equal-cell sheet, nothing crosses cell boundary.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: TRANSPARENT modular robot component sprite atlas, exactly THREE columns by TWO rows of equal SQUARE cells. No text, no labels, no grid lines, no background, no ground shadows or checkerboard. Input image design reference. Match the reference's sophisticated realistic stylized rendered game artwork: ivory polymer, graphite undercarriages, brushed champagne metal, muted burnt orange and teal, small status slits, believable soft amber/cyan arena lighting, readable robust silhouettes, no cartoon outlines or giant robot eyes. Assets for a side-view 2D physics game.
Every component entirely isolated in central 75% of its own square cell, aligned to exact regular grid, fully visible with padding. Side-view game camera, consistent scale and light.
TOP LEFT cell: compact luggage-assistant hazard with ivory capsule wheel base, teal status slit, jointed champagne arm and oversized coral-red horseshoe MAGNET opening toward RIGHT. Full robot including magnet, recognizable at small scale.
TOP MIDDLE cell: compact FITNESS COACH robot BODY ONLY, ivory rounded torso with graphite wheel base, amber horizontal status slit, coral shoulder sockets. NO arms, gloves, hands or head on stalk. Arms and gloves are animated separately in code.
TOP RIGHT cell: EXPRESS BELLHOP PORTER matching reference, ground wheeled robot facing RIGHT, ivory concierge body with a small brass bell dome, amber horizontal status slit, low swept-back luggage rail, neatly stacked cream and burnt-orange cases secured by graphite strap, two rubber wheels with champagne hubs. Full distinct trolley silhouette.
BOTTOM LEFT cell: SPRING ROBOT BASE ONLY, low sculpted oval ivory-and-orange pedestal with two stabilizer feet, graphite base and a central top coil socket. NO spring, no upper cap. Full component centered.
BOTTOM MIDDLE cell: SPRING ROBOT UPPER CAP ONLY, broad padded orange oval disc with ivory thick bevel and a very small amber front slit, underside coil socket. NO spring, base or feet. Full component centered. Code will draw flexible steel coil between these two parts.
BOTTOM RIGHT cell: compact SPA DISPENSER robot, low rounded ivory tank body on small wheels, muted teal status light, champagne curved short pouring spout directed right and down, tiny embossed leaf pictogram. NO puddle or liquid: animated turquoise slime will be drawn in code.
A single clean 3x2 modular atlas. No duplicate components, no extra objects, no human characters. Truly transparent alpha outside the six component silhouettes.
